# #4037: Patch: remove the "How JackiOh uses AI" page (/ai)
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What

The owner wants the public **How JackiOh uses AI** page, `/ai` (https://staging.jackioh.com/ai), removed from the site. It was added in #2631 under **R2631000**. Take it out completely: the route, its footer link, its title, its sitemap and static-page entries, its tests, and the docs that describe it.

**CLAUDE.md rule 13:** `/ai` is a public route that people can visit. A person asked for this removal directly, so the bot does not need to stop and ask.

## Where it lives (from a grep of `main`)

- `apps/web/src/routes/ai.tsx`: the page. Delete it.
- `apps/web/src/routes/ai.test.tsx`: its tests, which prove R2631000. Delete it.
- `apps/web/src/net/navigate.ts:241-242`: `paths.ai`.
- `apps/web/src/main.tsx:747`: the route dispatch, `if (path === paths.ai) return <AiRoute />`.
- `apps/web/src/routes/chunks.tsx:78`: the lazy chunk `ai: routeChunk(...)`.
- `apps/web/src/net/head.ts:35`: the document title, "How JackiOh uses AI".
- `apps/web/src/routes/SiteFooter.tsx`: the "AI use" footer link (around line 59), `siteFooterTestid.ai`, and the header comment's mention of the page.
- `apps/web/static-pages.ts`: the sitemap entry (around line 62) and the quoted page text (around line 218).
- Tests that list the page: `apps/web/src/static-pages.test.ts` (lines 45 and 365), `apps/web/src/routes/page-names.test.tsx:31`, `apps/web/src/routes/engine-gate.test.tsx:149`, and `e2e/cypress/e2e/38-accessibility.cy.ts` (lines 67 and 216-217).
- `docs/compliance.md` §9, "How JackiOh uses AI (R2631000)". Remove the section or rewrite it so it no longer points at a page that is gone. Check whether any other section refers to it.
- `assets/voice/SOURCES.md:3` cites #2631 and R2631000. The voice-sources record stays. Only reword the line if it mentions the page itself.
- Nothing else should reference `AI_LAST_UPDATED` or `MUSIC_SOURCES_URL` once `ai.tsx` is gone. Delete them, and move them only if something outside the page still reads them.

Do not touch `@jackioh/ai`, `wire/ai.ts` or the practice AI. They share the name but have nothing to do with this page.

## The ruling

R2631000's proving test goes away along with the page, so `cargo jackioh spec check` will fail until the ruling is handled. Record the removal as a new ruling in this issue's block, numbered by CLAUDE.md rule 3. It should say that the owner asked for `/ai` to be removed, and it should amend or withdraw R2631000 the same way other amended rulings are handled (see R2756000's title, "amended by …"). Put its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<N>.md`. Back it with a proving test, for example a web test that `/ai` is no longer in the footer, the sitemap or `static-pages.ts`, and that the path falls through to whatever the router does for any unknown path. Fix any other R-id citations that `spec check` flags.

## Acceptance

- `/ai` no longer renders the page. It behaves like any other unknown path.
- The site footer has no "AI use" link. `/ai` is in neither the sitemap nor `static-pages.ts`.
- `docs/compliance.md` no longer describes the page.
- These pass: `cargo jackioh spec check`, `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/edge apps/web e2e`, and the e2e accessibility spec (`38-accessibility.cy.ts`).
- The change ships no card data, so no patch fragment should be needed. Confirm this with `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`.

## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43787689410)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Record the removal as new ruling R4037000 amending R2631000, with a proving web test, so `cargo jackioh spec check` passes; confirm with `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` that no patch fragment is needed.

|---|---|---|

| `apps/web/src/static-pages.test.ts` | change | Remove `AiRoute` import and `[AiRoute, paths.ai]` quote-check row |

Do not touch: `@jackioh/ai`, `wire/ai.ts`, the practice AI, anything under `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, or the folded `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`, `spec/CARDS.md` (the daily fold owns them). Governing notes: R2631000 (amended), R3011000 (removal precedent to copy), R2756000 (title pattern); CLAUDE.md rules 3 (new ruling) and 13 (owner asked directly, no need to ask).

## Steps

1. Delete `apps/web/src/routes/ai.tsx` and `apps/web/src/routes/ai.test.tsx`. Verify nothing else imports them: only `main.tsx`, `static-pages.test.ts`, `page-titles.test.tsx` do (checked).
2. In `apps/web/src/net/navigate.ts`, delete the `/** R2631000: how JackiOh uses AI. */ ai: "/ai",` lines from `paths`.
3. In `apps/web/src/routes/chunks.tsx`, delete the `ai: routeChunk(() => import("./ai.tsx")),` line.
4. In `apps/web/src/main.tsx`, delete `const AiRoute = routeChunks.ai.Screen;` and the `if (path === paths.ai) return <AiRoute />;` line. `/ai` now falls to `return <NotFound path={path} />`.
5. In `apps/web/src/net/head.ts`, delete the `case paths.ai:` arm. `screenNameFor("/ai")` becomes `null`, so the title becomes `Page not found · JackiOh`, identical to any unknown path.
6. In `apps/web/public/_redirects`, delete `/ai /ai/ 200`.
7. In `apps/web/src/routes/SiteFooter.tsx`, delete the ai anchor, the `ai` testid entry, and the "how JackiOh uses AI (R2631000)" phrase in the header comment.
8. In `apps/web/static-pages.ts`, delete the `paths.ai` entry in `PUBLIC_PAGES` and the `[paths.ai]: …` block in `PAGE_TEXT`.
9. In `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`, delete the `"How JackiOh uses AI"` line.
10. Update the listing tests: `static-pages.test.ts` (import + quote-check row), `page-names.test.tsx` (ai row), `page-titles.test.tsx` (import + row), `engine-gate.test.tsx` (`["/ai", "ai-screen"]` row), `38-accessibility.cy.ts` (`SCREEN.ai` + `it("/ai")` block).
11. Write `apps/web/src/routes/ai-removed.test.tsx`, copying the `beforeEach`/`afterEach` fetch-stub pattern from the deleted `ai.test.tsx`. One test, titled so both ruling ids read as words, e.g. `it("R4037000 removes /ai, amending R2631000: no footer link, sitemap or static page, and the path draws NotFound like any unknown path", …)`. Confirm the NotFound testid against `main.tsx`'s `NotFound` before asserting.
12. Write `spec/rulings/R4037000.md`, mirroring `R3011000.md`'s shape: front matter with title `"/ai is removed: no page, footer link, title, sitemap, static-page or redirect entry (issue #4037; amends R2631000)"`, `cards: "R2631000, issue #4037"`, `proven_in: [apps/web/src/routes/ai-removed.test.tsx]`; body says the owner asked for removal, lists what was taken out, notes `SOURCES.md` keeps the voice record and `/ai` now 404s; rejected: keeping a stub or redirect page.
13. Edit `spec/rulings/R2631000.md`: change trailing `(issue #2631)` to `(issue #2631; amended by R4037000)`, append `R4037000` to `cards`, append `Amended by [[R4037000]] (#4037): …` as the last paragraph, set `proven_in` to the new test file.
14. Write `spec/pending/4037.md` in the style of `spec/pending/3937.md`: `**[[R4037000]] … (issue #4037, <today's date>; amends [[R2631000]])**: …`.
15. In `docs/compliance.md`, delete §9 through end of file. In `assets/voice/SOURCES.md`, reword to e.g. "Where every spoken card line the client plays came from (issue #2631, R2631000), beside the music's `assets/music/LICENSES.md`. The lines are computer text-to-speech; this is the record of how they are made."

## Tests

- New `apps/web/src/routes/ai-removed.test.tsx` as in step 11; run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/routes/ai-removed.test.tsx`.
- Regression files, each by `pnpm --dir apps/web test <file>`: `src/static-pages.test.ts`, `src/routes/page-names.test.tsx`, `src/routes/page-titles.test.tsx`, `src/routes/engine-gate.test.tsx`, `src/net/deploy-routes.test.ts` (covers `_redirects` vs route table), `src/net/cloudflare-serve.test.ts`, `src/i18n/i18n.test.ts` (zh-CN entry removal), plus neighbours that render the footer: `src/routes/privacy.test.tsx`, `src/routes/almanac.test.tsx`, `src/routes/patch-notes.test.tsx`.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/edge apps/web e2e`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` (expect no card data, no fragment). The e2e accessibility spec needs the `E2E=1` dev server + server per CLAUDE.md; run `cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/38-accessibility.cy.ts` if the environment allows, else leave it to CI and say so.

## Done when

- [ ] `/ai` draws `NotFound` with the unknown-path title; footer, sitemap, `static-pages.ts`, `_redirects`, titles, zh-CN dict name it nowhere; `AI_LAST_UPDATED`/`MUSIC_SOURCES_URL` are gone with the page.
- [ ] `docs/compliance.md` has no §9; `SOURCES.md` keeps its record without pointing at the page.
- [ ] R4037000 note + `spec/pending/4037.md` exist, R2631000 note amended, new test names both ids.
- [ ] `spec check`, typecheck, eslint, touched-file web tests, and classify (no fragment) pass; e2e accessibility spec run or handed to CI explicitly.

## Risks

- `deploy-routes.test.ts` also asserts every `paths` value is served: removing from both sides keeps it green; removing from only one side fails it either way, so steps 2 and 6 are one unit.
- The folded `spec/11-rulings.md` paragraph for R2631000 keeps describing the page (as R2756000's did after R3011000); the daily fold only appends the new paragraph. Accepted per precedent, not edited.
- `page-names.test.tsx` also checks the command menu: `/ai` was never in `commandPages()`, so no menu change is needed.
- zh-CN removal is enforced by no test (i18n tests check the live direction only), so a stale entry would be silent; step 9 handles it.

None.
